svg.title: Three ways a rocket plume digs a crater
svg.desc: Three side-by-side cross-sections. Viscous erosion: gas shear strips grains and leaves a broad, shallow scour. Bearing capacity failure: a tight, high-pressure jet punches the soil down into a deep, narrow crater. Diffused gas eruption: gas packed into the soil pores bursts back out when thrust drops, blowing soil upward.
